//: Story Phase 2, chapter 8: The Trial of Garrick Guzzlegut. Trial layout (TRIAL placements): Garrick tied at (9,21), Squawks (11,21), the captain at (9,23). Frigate: helm (9,6), sail cleat (8,30), rowboat (4,24).

ch8.begin.narrate: Sundown. The sea turns to copper, the crew assembles on the main deck, and Mags finishes knitting something small, red and urgent.

start: The whole crew stands in a half-circle round the mainmast. Garrick is tied to it. He is trying to look like a man who chose to be there.
Captain Squawks sits on a barrelhead in a knitted red sweater and a tiny matching cap. Nobody has mentioned it. Nobody is going to.
squawks[smug]: Mags made it. It's cashmere.
mags: It's sheep.
squawks[smug]: It's CASHMERE.
quill: The Ship versus Garrick Guzzlegut. Captain Blackbeard presiding. I have the charges here.

start.caption: Written up by Quill in his best hand, with footnotes.

charges: quill: Charge the first: ruining the treasure.
garrick[businesslike]: Objection. 'Ruining' is a strong word. I'd say 'accelerated depreciation'.
quill: Charge the second: poisoning the air.
quill: Charge the third: damaging the ship.
garrick: I'm still working on that one.
quill: Charge the fourth: nearly fumigating Captain Squawks.
garrick[businesslike]: 'Involuntary maritime restructuring'. Of a parrot.
squawks[furious]: GUILTY! GUILTY! I VOTE GUILTY!
quill: We haven't got to the vote yet, Squawks.
squawks[furious]: I'm voting EARLY! GUILTY TWICE!
captain: The accused may speak in his defence. Briefly.
defence: garrick[businesslike]: Thank you, Captain. Members of the jury. Esteemed captain. Bald parrot.
garrick: Yes, the treasure is ruined. Yes, the ship smells like the inside of a boot.
garrick[delighted]: But consider the upside! Nobody will EVER steal from you again. Yours is the most secure gold on the seven seas. You can't give it away!
captain[annoyed]: We TRIED to give it away.
garrick[smug]: And nobody took it! That's security, Captain.
garrick: And look at Captain Squawks. He's never looked better.
garrick[smug]: Before, he looked like a feather duster. Now he looks like a plucked chicken in a jumper, which is a real step up for—
garrick[terrified]: GET IT OFF! GET IT OFF MY SIDEBURNS!
You snatch Squawks out of the air mid-lunge and tuck him under your arm, where he continues to kick.
squawks[furious]: Let me at him! Let me at his SIDEBURNS! I'll restructure HIM!
captain: Easy. Easy, Squawks. We'll do this properly.
punish: mags[angry]: Make him scrub every plank on this ship. With his own toothbrush.
jim: Make him eat my cooking. Plain. No pickle.
wick: Make him wear the sweater!

then: garrick[terrified]: Captain, I can't swim! I can only float, and only in bathtubs!
captain: Scrubbing duty. Every plank. Every day. Until the smell comes out.
garrick[nervous]: Captain, respectfully... the smell is never coming out.
garrick[relieved]: Take all the time you need, Captain. Weeks. Years.

ship: ned[alarmed]: SAIL HO! SHIP APPROACHING! OFF THE PORT QUARTER!
nell[alarmed]: A frigate, Captain! Royal Navy. Forty guns if she's got one.
hale[alarmed]: They're running out their guns!

ship.say: crew: PIRATE VESSEL! HEAVE TO AND PREPARE TO BE BOARDED, IN THE NAME OF THE CROWN!
ship.name: Navy Captain

ship: captain[alarmed]: We can't outrun a frigate. Not in this wind. Not with a hold full of— of whatever that is now.
garrick[businesslike]: Captain! Untie me! I have an idea. A business proposal!
garrick: The sail! The spare foresail that was drying over the main hatch during the Gust! It's soaked right through!
garrick[greedy]: Put us upwind of them and let it go. The wind does the delivery. We just open the package.

then: hale: It's insane, Captain. It might also work.

ship: Rook cuts Garrick's ropes with one swipe.
captain[determined]: ALL HANDS! Nell, clear the helm, I'm taking her myself! Rook, Brask, the foresail! Guzzlegut, with me!

ch8.stations: nell[happy]: She's yours, Captain! Bring her round and put the wind at our backs!

ch8.stations.tutorial: Take the helm (at the stern) to bring the ship upwind of the frigate.
ch8.stations.title: The Yellow Defense

ch8.take_helm: captain[determined]: Hard a-starboard! Bring her ROUND!
The Revenge heels hard over. Canvas cracks and fills. The wind swings round until it's blowing straight from you... to them.
nell[happy]: We're upwind of her, Captain! Wind's at our backs and straight down her throat!

ch8.take_helm.say: garrick: THE SAIL, CAPTAIN! The foremast cleat! Pull the pin!
ch8.take_helm.name: Garrick (from the foredeck)

ch8.take_helm.tutorial: Release the fouled sail at the foremast cleat, on the foredeck.
ch8.take_helm.title: The Yellow Defense

start: captain[smug]: Let's see how the Navy likes the smell of money.
The fouled sail tears loose, bellies out like a great yellow ghost, and goes sailing off downwind.

start.say: crew: ...What's that? Is that a SAIL?
start.name: Navy Lookout

start.say: crew: ABANDON— no— TURN! TURN THE SHIP! TURN IT AWAY FROM THE SMELL!
start.name: Navy Captain

start: garrick[smug]: Asset deployment, Captain. Textbook.
captain: Guzzlegut. Front and centre.
captain: You ruined my treasure. You gassed my ship. You nearly killed my parrot.
captain: And you just saw off forty royal guns with a bedsheet.
garrick[relieved]: A sail, Captain. A premium sail.

then: hale: Captain... he did just save it.
garrick[relieved]: Captain... thank you. Truly. No one's given me a second chance since the harbourmaster. And he gave it to me off the end of a dock.

start: quill: I took the liberty of drafting the terms, Captain.

start.caption: Drafted by Quill. Signed by both parties. Witnessed by one furious parrot.

start: captain: One. No more fermented eel paste. Ever.
jim: Hear, hear!
captain: Two. No entering the treasure room after meals.
garrick: Define 'meal'.
captain[angry]: ANYTHING you put in your MOUTH.
captain: Three. Any unusual stomach noise, and you get in the rowboat and you row half a mile off. Downwind. Until it passes.
garrick[businesslike]: Half a mile. Downwind. Understood. I accept these terms, and may I say this is the beginning of a long and fruitful partnership—
rowboat: Silence. The whole crew turns, very slowly, to look at Garrick.

rowboat.text: HALF A MILE! I KNOW! I KNOW!

rowboat: squawks[smug]: ...I'm starting to like the rules on this ship.

ch8.epilogue.narrate: And so the Queen Anne's Revenge sailed on across the Sapphire Sea...
...leaving a faint yellow trail on the evening air behind her.
Merchant ships gave her a wide berth. So did the gulls. So did the fish.
And half a mile downwind, a small rowboat bobbed along behind her, its passenger in excellent spirits.
Every so often, far out on the water, a small yellow cloud rose gently into the sunset.

ch8.epilogue: squawks[furious]: DEADLY BREW! DEADLY BREEEW! EVERYBODY UPWIND!

ch8.epilogue.sub: Garrick Guzzlegut and the Cursed Treasure

ch8.coda: The next morning. The treasure is still ruined. The ship still smells. Garrick is back aboard, and on his best behaviour.

ch8.coda.tutorial: Story Phase 2 is complete. The ship is yours to explore; the crew have plenty to say about the last day. The story continues in the next chapter.
ch8.coda.title: To Be Continued
